title: fix(ui/scripts): read a drift side in one git process; build the import fixture at collection time
body:
Fixes #32564

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`check:i18n-drift` 读某个提交上的全部语言包时,从「每个文件起一个 `git show` 进程」(11 种语言 × 3 个文件 = 每侧 33 个进程)改成「一个 `git cat-file --batch` 进程读完」;那条超时测试的四提交 git 夹具挪到收集阶段构建,与同文件的 `layout()` 一致。
- 为什么改:Test UI (1/16) 上这条测试在 15 秒预算里跑了约 120 个串行 git 子进程,繁忙的 CI 机器上会超时(运行 43155985148 第 1 次红,重跑绿,改动与 `ui/` 无关);慢的是进程启动,不是读取。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `ui/scripts` 下的一个门禁脚本和一个测试文件,不发布任何包;门禁的判定结果不变(既有 223 条用例全绿)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` 的 `showAllAt()`(按字节解析 batch 输出那一段是风险点);`ui/scripts/__tests__/git-paths-nested-layout.test.ts` 的 `importHistory()`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/git-paths-nested-layout.test.ts`,预期 12 条全绿,首条用例约 0.1–0.3 秒(改前约 1.3 秒)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`ui/scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs`** — `readPacks(root, ref)` read each file of a side with its own `git show` (`gitQuiet`): every locale pack plus its two partial packs, 33 spawns per side at the current eleven-tag table. A new private `showAllAt(root, ref, rels)` reads the whole side through ONE `git cat-file --batch` process and answers, per file, exactly what `gitQuiet(['show', revPath(ref, rel)])` answered: the blob trimmed, or `null` where the name resolves to nothing (`missing` / `ambiguous`, an unknown ref, a failed process). It keeps `revPath`'s `REF:./PATH` spelling, which `cat-file --batch` resolves relative to the tree git runs in exactly as `git show` does (probed in a nested scratch repo, and covered by both layouts in the test file). A non-blob at a pack path throws rather than parsing a tree listing. The throw order and messages of `readPacks` are unchanged: `en` still throws `cannot read ...` before any follower is handled.
- **`ui/scripts/__tests__/git-paths-nested-layout.test.ts`** — the import-case test built its four-commit history inside the `it`. It now builds it at collection time in `importHistory()`, the same way `layout()` already does for the other describes, so the test's budget holds only the reads it asserts on. Every assertion is unchanged.

**Route taken, and why.** Measured first (idle box, `PATH` shim counting `git` spawns): the file spawned 367 `git` processes, 302 of them `git show`; the failing test alone was about 120 spawns, of which about 100 were the script's per-file reads inside three `analyze()` calls. So the cost was the script's, and cutting it there was the route that removes the work instead of moving it. Shrinking `LOCALES` was not an option without stubbing the module's frozen locale table, and a per-test budget was not needed once the work was cut. The fixture move then takes the remaining git setup (about 0.5 s idle) out of the timed window.

## Tests

```
base 3452dec21 : 367 git spawns for the file (302 show, 10 cat-file); import test 1339 ms; the two "reads the base packs" tests 925 / 944 ms
this PR        :  81 git spawns for the file (  6 show, 20 cat-file); import test  615 ms before the fixture move; the two others 66 / 56 ms
```

Scenario timing outside vitest (the import test's own steps, cumulative ms): base `analyze1` +247, `analyze3` +395; this PR `analyze1` +32, `analyze3` +29.
</details>

<details><summary>Repeat under CPU contention: 30 of 30 green, p95 332 ms</summary>

30 sequential runs of the file, each beside a `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` of the whole ui scripts tree and a looping `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/` (4-core box, all under the shared verify lock, 12m07s held):

```

import test (ms)           min 90 · median 193 · p95 332 · max 370      (budget 15000)
whole file (ms)            median 689 · p95 1518 · max 1768
scenario outside vitest    base median 1646 · p95 3074 · max 4290
  (same load, same 30 laps) this PR median 883 · p95 1303 · max 1401
```
</details>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` at e5240c997 (derived family): `Test Files 171 passed | 2 skipped (173)`, `Tests 5062 passed | 2 skipped (5064)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `answers.set(rel, body.toString('utf8').trim());` with `answers.set(rel, null);` (anchor 1 to 0, blob 47e381f6ea34 to cd80f8b65927) and ran the file: `Tests 3 failed | 9 passed (12)` (the import test and both layouts' "reads the base packs" test). Restored: blob after restore == HEAD blob 47e381f6ea34, `git diff HEAD` empty. No permanent test was added for this.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The first `vitest run scripts/` (the one that served as contention load above) had 3 failures, each a 15 s timeout in a file this PR does not touch (`check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.test.ts`, `check-lint-rule-coverage.test.ts`, `js-comment-mask-returns-interpolation-9424.test.ts`), under load I induced on purpose. The clean re-run at the same head was all green. They are whole-tree scans that share this card's shape (a fixed 15 s budget on work that grows with the tree); noted, not filed, since there is no instance on an uncontended run.
- `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 on its first local run (its closure build waits on the shared lock) and 0 on the re-run: `OK — 0 ledger entr(ies) re-measured`.
- `skip-changeset`: the two paths are under the private `ui/` root package (`object-ui-monorepo`, `private: true`); nothing in any package's `files[]` moves.

## Verification

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 20 families at e5240c997), all exit 0: `check-closing-keyword-parity` (and `--self-test`), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `vitest run scripts/`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:registry-log-declared`, `check:rest-log-spy-declared`, `check:tier-file-adoption`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:where-matcher`. `--ran` reconciliation: `20 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 20 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 20 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
